hypothesis: A new unconditional PDC IRQ_PARAM MMIO read is unnecessary in SM8750 pass-through mode and may explain the reset before a console appears. Hardware cause remains unconfirmed.
code_evidence: IRQ_PARAM was not read by the running 7.2.15 driver.
All semantic uses of num_spis are guarded by PDC_SECONDARY_MODE.
SM8750 uses pass-through mode; secondary mode is selected only for the X1E firmware fallback.
change: Read IRQ_PARAM only in secondary mode; short-circuit the mapping loop on that mode. Keep the new upstream descriptor and GPIO secondary-mode implementation.
fallback: Original NixOS is running; global default nixos/current restored and original current alias retained.
